skills.name: merrin-time-derivative
skills.scope: Apply D_t P = v P_q + a P_v to an autonomous first-jet polynomial.
skills.boundary: Acceleration-dependent input would require a jerk coordinate and is refused. Explicit time dependence is outside this declared operator.

skills.name: merrin-euler-lagrange
skills.scope: Form E(L) = D_t(L_v) - L_q with a fixed sign convention.
skills.boundary: The input is an explicitly declared first-order autonomous toy Lagrangian. The result is a conditional residual, not a derivation of the historical GMUT tensor placeholders.

skills.name: merrin-energy-polynomial
skills.scope: Form H(q,v) = v L_v - L in jet coordinates.
skills.boundary: This expression is not automatically a Hamiltonian written in canonical momentum. No globally invertible Legendre map or physical energy interpretation is asserted.

skills.name: merrin-kinetic-point
skills.scope: Evaluate the velocity Hessian L_vv at a declared rational point.
skills.boundary: A nonzero Hessian marks a regular Legendre point in this finite model. A zero Hessian is not proof that every possible inverse fails; neither sign certifies global stability.

skills.name: merrin-energy-identity
skills.scope: Check the off-shell identity D_t H - v E(L) = 0 for autonomous first-order polynomials.
skills.boundary: The identity is conditional algebra. Conservation along an actual solution also requires the equations, a valid solution and the intended physical interpretation.

skills.name: merrin-potential-point
skills.scope: Evaluate the field derivative and curvature of a field-only potential.
skills.boundary: A stationary point with zero curvature is unresolved at quadratic order. No physical vacuum, stable state or measured parameter is established.

skills.name: merrin-boundary-equivalence
skills.scope: Compare a stated boundary addition D_t F(q) with the actual difference of two actions.
skills.boundary: The declared generator and residual comparison are separate outputs. Equal equations alone cannot establish every global boundary, topology or quantum equivalence claim.

skills.name: merrin-affine-pullback
skills.scope: Expand q = s Q + b and v = s V for a nonzero rational slope.
skills.boundary: The pullback is an invertible coordinate representation in the finite model. It is not a field-theory equivalence proof or a change in source evidence status.

skills.name: merrin-model-obligations
skills.scope: Project explicit missing evidence roles for five out-of-model claim classes.
skills.boundary: Providing all role labels only empties a bookkeeping list. It never verifies evidence contents, closes the source placeholders or grants scientific and production authority.

skills.name: merrin-release-gate
skills.scope: Retain five protected requests as exact gates under synthetic evidence.
skills.boundary: An authority string cannot grant authority. Real review, affected governance and Māori authority cannot be synthesized by a successful software check.
